reference.content: CT Head DLP ref ~700-800 mGy·cm; Chest CT ~400-600 mGy·cm; Coronary CTA ~800-1200 mGy·cm; DSA Coronary ~2000-4000 mGy·m²; Mammography ~3-6 mGy. Per GBZ 130-2020, exams exceeding guidance levels should undergo patient dose optimization analysis. Thresholds are based on national standards. AAPM ref values from AAPM recommendations; EU ref values from EU Commission guidelines.
